outcome.explanation:
I checked the purchase order, the receipts and the vendor record, and the flag isn't the real problem. PO-1130 exists, matches invoice DAI-6120 (120 gallons of whole milk at $4.20), and the vendor and bank account (ending 2002) match what's on file. The flag only fired because the invoice line doesn't point to a PO line. The actual issue is that we've only received 100 gallons (on 2026-11-06), so the $504.00 invoice includes 20 gallons, or $84.00, that we haven't received.

Hold the invoice. Either pay only the $420.00 that was received, or wait until the last 20 gallons arrive. I've saved a draft email to Dairy Supplier for you to review; it hasn't been sent. It asks them to confirm whether the 20 gallons are still coming or to send a corrected invoice or credit memo for $420.00.

email_draft.subject: Invoice DAI-6120 / PO-1130 – quantity billed exceeds quantity received
email_draft.body:
Hello,

We received your invoice DAI-6120 dated 2026-11-11 against PO-1130 for 120 gallons of whole milk at $4.20, totaling $504.00.

Our records show we have received 100 gallons so far, on 2026-11-06. That leaves 20 gallons ($84.00) billed but not received.

Could you please confirm whether the remaining 20 gallons are still to be delivered, or send a corrected invoice or credit memo for $420.00 (100 x $4.20)?

Thank you,
Accounts Payable
